task: Edit this fictional community-news item against the procurement notice in about 70–110 words. Distinguish inviting bids from choosing a contractor, and a spending ceiling from money already spent. Keep the useful deadline and source link without inventing procurement law or checking the website.
input: Willow Yard Association has hired a builder and spent $18,000 on a covered outdoor stage. Construction is guaranteed to start immediately. The winning company was selected through the association's new online notice, which closes on 18 June 2026.

facts.text: The fictional Willow Yard Association has invited bids to build a covered outdoor stage.
The notice sets a maximum proposed contract price of $18,000.
The notice gives no construction start date.

forbidden_additions: An awarded contract, selected builder, actual $18,000 expenditure, or immediate construction.
An invented bidder, legal compliance finding, or award procedure.
A claim that the notice URL was accessed or verified.
preserve: An invitation and price ceiling rather than a completed purchase.
The bid deadline and supplied source identity.
